battle.name: 西里西亞起義
battle.brief: 西里西亞起義於1919年1月在上西里西亞爆發，波蘭起義者反抗德國當局對爭議區的行政控制，成為波德邊境衝突的重要事件。起義期間的地方武裝使用施拿甫步槍（Sharps rifle），這款美國製早期前線步槍主要供步兵與武裝人員執行巡邏及防衛任務。

kit.name: 施拿甫步槍
kit.history: 施拿甫步槍是美國陸軍在十九世紀後半葉採用的制式步槍，主要配置於前線步兵與國民兵團，並成為地方武裝可使用的早期槍械。

countries: 1919年1月18日，戰火首先出現在德國治下的上西里西亞煤礦區東緣，起義者由茲熱姆別（Jastrzębie）、沃迪斯瓦夫（Wodzisław）、扎布熱（Zabrze）及達布羅瓦（Dąbrowa）等地向卡托維茲（Katowice）外圍擴散。當時德國仍以奧佩爾恩行政區治理北部與西部煤田，新生的波蘭則控制南側較小的切申西里西亞（Cieszyn Silesia）據點，兩國邊界直接穿過礦區、鐵路與城鎮。1月作戰主要是波蘭起義者對抗德國邊防、國民警衛隊與自由團；8月再起時，雙方都投入正規部隊。1920年8月底至9月，德方在卡普事件後轉守為攻；1921年1月，波蘭第6西里西亞師越過切申邊界，與德軍在普什琴、派斯科維采、希維爾克拉涅茨、科祖及海爾姆一線決戰。英法聯軍的觀察與進駐部隊出現在停火執行線上，捷克斯洛伐克控制南面相鄰邊區，但沒有成為主戰方。最後並非由一國占領整片西里西亞收束，而是由聯軍監督停火、公民投票及德波劃界委員會共同固定邊界。
countriesEn: The fighting began on 18 January 1919 on the eastern edge of the Upper Silesian coalfield under German rule, spreading from Jastrzębie, Wodzisław, Zabrze and Dąbrowa toward the outskirts of Katowice. Germany then governed the northern and western coalfield through the Oppeln administrative district, while the newly restored Polish state held the smaller Cieszyn Silesian salient to the south; the frontier ran directly through mines, railways and towns. The January conflict chiefly pitted Polish insurgents against the German Grenzschutz, police and Freikorps, although regular troops entered the fighting when the revolt revived in August. From late August to September 1920, the Germans switched from suppression to counteroffensive after the Kapp Putsch. In January 1921, the Polish 6th Silesian Division crossed the Cieszyn frontier and fought the Germans along the Pszczyna, Pyskowice, Świerklaniec, Kozu and Chelm axes. British and French Allied observers and troops appeared along the ceasefire line, while Czechoslovakia controlled the adjacent southern border but did not become a principal belligerent. The campaign did not end with either country occupying all of Upper Silesia; the frontier was ultimately fixed through an Allied-supervised ceasefire, a plebiscite and the German-Polish boundary commission.
people: 波蘭方面的核心並非單一將領，而是科爾凡蒂（Wojciech Korfanty）、總統畢蘇斯基（Józef Piłsudski）及軍方指揮系統共同構成的政治與軍事鏈條。科爾凡蒂主持1920年4月12日成立的切申波蘭民族議會，議會軍事機構把起義者編成上西里西亞軍；前軍官Ludwik Pierzchała、Alojzy Minda與Florian Cichon先後出現在這支部隊的指揮鏈中。科爾凡蒂主張迅速擴大行動，畢蘇斯基的參謀系統則把正規兵力和重武器集中於切申，直到1921年才以第6西里西亞師投入決定性攻勢。德國方面，漢斯·馮·齊克特（Hans von Seeckt）掌握西里西亞的整體軍事部署，威廉·沃伊爾施（Wilhelm Woyrsch）在8月第二階段指揮邊防與正規軍壓制起義；弗里德里希·卡普（Friedrich Kapp）所代表的德國軍官及退伍人員網，則在第三階段提供突擊骨幹。聯軍方面由哈里·諾克斯（Harry Knox）主持西里西亞軍事管制委員會，並在最後階段調動英法部隊執行停火。波蘭志願兵的訓練、補給與指揮一致性明顯低於第6師；德軍則擁有較完整的炮兵、機槍及鐵路調度能力，這些差異比個人英雄更能解釋各階段勝負。
peopleEn: The Polish side was not directed by a single general but by a political and military chain linking Wojciech Korfanty, President Józef Piłsudski and the army command. Korfanty headed the Polish National Council established at Cieszyn on 12 April 1920, whose military organization formed the Upper Silesian Army; former officers Ludwik Pierzchała, Alojzy Minda and Florian Cichon appeared at successive points in its command chain. Korfanty pressed for a rapid expansion of the revolt, while Piłsudski’s general staff concentrated regular troops and heavy weapons in Cieszyn and only committed the 6th Silesian Division to the decisive offensive in January 1921. On the German side, Hans von Seeckt controlled the overall military disposition in Silesia, while Wilhelm Woyrsch directed the Grenzschutz and regular army during the suppression of the August 1919 rising. The network of German officers and former soldiers associated with Friedrich Kapp supplied much of the assault strength in the third phase. On the Allied side, Harry Knox headed the Inter-Allied Military Control Commission in Upper Silesia and brought British and French troops into the final ceasefire enforcement. The Polish volunteers’ training, supply and command cohesion were markedly below those of the 6th Division, whereas the Germans possessed more complete artillery, machine-gun support and railway transport. These differences explain the course of the fighting more effectively than the reputation of any individual commander.
kits: 波蘭起義者的主要步槍包括奧匈帝國的Steyr M1888/90、Mannlicher M1895步槍與短槍系列，以及俄製Mosin-Nagant M1891/30；波蘭第6西里西亞師另配備Karabin wz. 1895、舊式Karabin wz. 1897和Mosin-Nagant。自動武器以從奧匈軍庫或德軍手中取得的Maxim MG 08/15及Schwarzlose M07/12最為重要，這些機槍使缺乏炮兵支援的起義者仍能鞏固車站與城鎮陣地。德軍使用標準Gewehr 98，配MG 08/15、少量較重的MG 08，以及8 cm FK 96野戰砲、10.5 cm leFH 16輕型野戰榴彈砲和7 cm Granatwerfer 16迫擊砲；波蘭軍則有7.5 cm wz. 1897/13野戰砲等舊式火炮。單槍包括Luger P08及Reichsrevolver M1879，英軍部署則配SMLE No. 1 Mk III步槍與Vickers機槍。彈藥並未統一：德軍主要使用7.92×57公厘，奧地利機槍同樣使用7.92×57公厘，俄制步槍使用7.62×54公厘R，英軍使用.303英制；8 cm FK 96消耗8×80公厘R砲彈，10.5 cm leFH 16使用10.5×105公厘R砲彈。起義者最常受制於不同口徑無法互通，以及MG 08/15所屬7.92公厘彈藥供應短暫。運輸主要依靠卡托維茲—達布羅瓦—扎布熱主線通往沃迪斯瓦夫、希維爾克拉涅茨與塔爾諾夫斯凱古雷的鐵路，再以馬車完成末端運輸；前沿單位則使用野戰電話、手榴彈和信號器材。上述型號並非每支部隊都同時配備。
kitsEn: The principal rifles of the Polish insurgents included the Austro-Hungarian Steyr M1888/90, the Mannlicher M1895 rifle and carbine family, and the Russian Mosin-Nagant M1891/30. The Polish 6th Silesian Division also used the Karabin wz. 1895, obsolete Karabin wz. 1897 carbines and Mosin-Nagant rifles. Their principal automatic weapons were Maxim MG 08/15 and Schwarzlose M07/12 machine guns obtained from Austro-Hungarian stocks or captured from German forces; these allowed insurgents without artillery to consolidate positions around railway stations and towns. The Germans used the standard Gewehr 98, supported by MG 08/15, a smaller number of heavier MG 08 machine guns, 8 cm FK 96 field guns, 10.5 cm leFH 16 light field howitzers and 7 cm Granatwerfer 16 mortars. Polish forces possessed older artillery such as the 7.5 cm wz. 1897/13 field gun. Sidearms included the Luger P08 and Reichsrevolver M1879, while British deployments carried the SMLE No. 1 Mk III rifle and Vickers machine gun. Ammunition was not standardized: German rifles and Austrian machine guns normally used 7.92×57 mm, Russian rifles used 7.62×54 mmR, and British troops used .303-inch ammunition. The 8 cm FK 96 consumed 8×80 mmR rounds, while the 10.5 cm leFH 16 used 10.5×105 mmR shells. Insurgent weakness most often arose from incompatible calibres and temporary shortages of 7.92 mm ammunition for the MG 08/15. Transport depended chiefly on the Katowice–Dąbrowa–Zabrze trunk railway and its branches toward Wodzisław, Świerklaniec and Tarnowskie Góry, with horse carts completing the final distances; forward units also relied on field telephones, grenades and signalling equipment. No single formation possessed all of these items at once.
tactics: 1月第一階段，起義者以小組同時攻取車站、警察哨所和通信點，依靠突然出現的局部優勢迅速擴張，卻缺乏能持續壓住德軍反擊的炮兵；德方則沿鐵路調動邊防與武裝警察，在達布羅瓦、扎布熱等路口集中機槍和火炮，再以縱深機動逐段奪回市區，因此起義者即使一度占領城鎮，也難以長期守住。8月第二階段，起義軍的編組與協同明顯提高，先後向沃迪斯瓦夫、戈杜夫及達布羅瓦方向攻擊；在達布羅瓦，德軍利用既有工事、交叉射界、MG 08/15及砲兵封鎖接近道路，波蘭攻擊因缺乏同等重火力和連續補給而受阻，德軍預備隊反擊又迫使起義軍放棄部分城鎮。9月第三階段，德軍取得主動權，沿卡托維茲北側道路與通往塔爾諾夫斯凱古雷的鐵路軸線推進；在9月19日至22日的「鐵絲網之戰」中，波軍依托Boguszyce、Wire及Kalety附近的鐵絲網、坡地和電話線構筑陣地，德軍則用機槍與榴彈砲壓制暴露目標，再以步兵切斷各陣地聯繫，波軍因此退往南部。9月底至10月由切申方向發動的反擊未能扭轉局勢。1921年1月，第6西里西亞師先以師屬砲兵集中支援，再沿普什琴—派斯科維采與希維爾克拉涅茨—海爾姆兩條主要道路推進；德軍仍以機槍、砲兵和縱深據點抵抗，但聯軍部隊進駐關鍵車站並要求立即停火，使攻勢無法繼續擴展。
tacticsEn: During the first phase in January, insurgents used small groups to seize railway stations, police posts and communications points at the same time, relying on sudden local superiority to expand rapidly but lacking artillery capable of suppressing a German counterattack. The Germans moved Grenzschutz and armed police along the railways, concentrated machine guns and artillery at junctions such as Dąbrowa and Zabrze, and retook urban districts section by section with reserves operating in depth. Insurgents therefore struggled to hold towns even after briefly occupying them. In the second phase in August, organization and coordination improved markedly. The insurgent forces attacked toward Wodzisław, Godów and Dąbrowa in turn. At Dąbrowa, the Germans used existing fortifications, intersecting fields of fire, MG 08/15 machine guns and artillery to block the approaches. Lacking equivalent heavy support and continuous supply, the Polish attacks stalled, and a German counterattack forced the insurgents to abandon several positions. In the third phase in September, the Germans seized the initiative and advanced along the roads north of Katowice and toward the railway to Tarnowskie Góry. In the Battle of the Wire from 19 to 22 September, Polish troops constructed positions around Boguszyce, Wire and Kalety, using wire obstacles, high ground and telephone lines. German machine guns and howitzers pinned exposed targets, while infantry severed the connections between positions, forcing the Polish force south. The Polish counterattack from the Cieszyn direction in late September and October could not reverse the situation. In January 1921, the 6th Silesian Division first concentrated its divisional artillery, then advanced along the Pszczyna–Pyskowice and Świerklaniec–Chelm axes. German machine guns, artillery and prepared positions continued to provide resistance, but Allied troops entered key railway stations and demanded an immediate ceasefire, preventing further expansion of the offensive.
data: 可核對的時間線分為五段：第一階段始於1919年1月18日的茲熱姆別罷工，1月20日起迅速擴至沃迪斯瓦夫、扎布熱、達布羅瓦等地；1月24日至25日，達布羅瓦與扎布熱一線發生最激烈的正面交火，至2月10日前後，公開作戰大半被壓低。第二階段始於8月14日的總罷工，8月19日前後起義者進入沃迪斯瓦夫；8月21日至24日形成達布羅瓦戰鬥，8月23日戈杜夫一度易手，8月24日至26日德軍反擊並重占主要城鎮。第三階段在8月底展開，9月19日至22日的「鐵絲網之戰」以德軍控制Boguszyce、Wire、Kalety及塔爾諾夫斯凱古雷一線告終，零星戰鬥延續至10月。最後一階段由波蘭第6西里西亞師於1921年1月17日投入開始，1月18日至21日的主要戰場在戈萊尤夫、布熱日尼察、科祖、希維爾克拉涅茨與海爾姆周邊。聯軍干預後，戰線在1月下旬固定。公民投票於3月20日至4月20日舉行：德國取得1,096,954票，占59.4%；波蘭取得718,387票，占38.8%；奧地利取得7,822票，占0.4%；無效票20,781票，占1.1%。各行政區依本地結果劃分，因此全國總比例不能直接換成兩國所得土地比例。現存德、波檔案對傷亡、俘虜及失蹤的統計口徑不一，沒有可可靠核驗的總傷亡數，本實錄不列任何未經確定的總數。
dataEn: The verifiable chronology falls into five phases. The first began with the Jastrzębie strike on 18 January 1919 and spread by 20 January to Wodzisław, Zabrze, Dąbrowa and nearby towns; the fiercest frontal fighting around Dąbrowa and Zabrze occurred on 24–25 January, and most open fighting had been suppressed by about 10 February. The second phase began with the general strike of 14 August. Insurgents entered Wodzisław around 19 August, the Battle of Dąbrowa developed from 21 to 24 August, Godów changed hands briefly on 23 August, and a German counterattack on 24–26 August recovered the principal towns. The third phase opened in late August and ended its decisive action with the German-controlled Boguszyce–Wire–Kalety–Tarnowskie Góry line following the Battle of the Wire on 19–22 September, although isolated fighting continued into October. The final phase began when the Polish 6th Silesian Division entered the struggle on 17 January 1921; the principal battles from 18 to 21 January took place around Golejów, Brzeżnica, Kozu, Świerklaniec and Chelm. Allied intervention fixed the front in late January. The plebiscite was held from 20 March to 20 April: Germany received 1,096,954 votes, or 59.4 per cent; Poland received 718,387, or 38.8 per cent; Austria received 7,822, or 0.4 per cent; and 20,781 invalid votes represented 1.1 per cent. Because each administrative district followed its local result, the overall percentages cannot be converted directly into the territory awarded to either state. German and Polish surviving records use inconsistent definitions for casualties, prisoners and missing personnel, and no reliably verified aggregate casualty total exists; none is therefore invented here.
cause: 起義的根源是第一次世界大戰後尚未確定的德波邊界，而不是單一軍事事故。戰前德國長期治理上西里西亞，煤礦、鋼鐵和鐵路對德國經濟具有重大價值；1918年波蘭復國後，波蘭組織主張把多數波蘭人口聚居的西里西亞併入新國家，協約國則承諾以公民投票決定其歸屬。這種政治安排從未配合一套能立即執行的新行政權限，德國邊防仍控制城鎮和鐵路，波蘭武裝團體則能從切申越境支援，二者之間形成長期對抗。直接原因隨三個階段改變：1月18日礦區罷工爆發，使原本要求政治歸屬的行動迅速武裝化；8月的總罷工則與聯軍委員會準備在投票前改變德方治安控制、而德方未完全配合有關。1920年3月卡普事件削弱了魏瑪政府對軍隊的控制，也鼓勵德國軍官介入西里西亞，使8月底出現較大規模的德方反攻。1921年1月，投票日期與邊境安全問題逼近，波蘭協方以正規軍接替志願兵投入，聯軍的監察期限則迫使交戰各方停止再把戰線向投票區推進。
causeEn: The uprising arose from an unresolved German-Polish frontier after the First World War rather than from a single military incident. Germany had governed Upper Silesia for a long period, and its coal, steel and railway systems were of major economic value to the country. After Poland was restored in 1918, Polish organizations argued that Upper Silesia, where Polish speakers were concentrated, should be incorporated into the new state, while the Allies promised to determine its affiliation through a plebiscite. That political arrangement never received an administrative authority capable of implementing it immediately: German security forces continued to control towns and railways, while Polish armed organizations could cross from Cieszyn to provide assistance, creating a persistent confrontation. The immediate cause changed with each phase. The mining strike of 18 January 1919 transformed a demand for political affiliation into armed action. The general strike of August was connected with the Inter-Allied Commission’s preparations to change German security control before the vote and German resistance to full implementation. The Kapp Putsch of March 1920 weakened the Weimar government’s control of the armed forces and encouraged German officers to intervene in Upper Silesia, contributing to the larger German counteroffensive from late August. By January 1921 the voting date and frontier-security question were pressing; the Polish authorities replaced volunteer action with a regular division, while the Allied inspection timetable forced the belligerents to stop extending the front into the plebiscite area.
impact: 從軍事影響看，三次大規模起義證明，起義軍可以藉分散攻擊和鐵路節點迅速奪取城市，卻很難把暫時控制轉成可防守的戰區。第一、二階段的主要限制不是武器數量，而是重砲不足、口徑混雜、指揮分散與鄉間補給線脆弱；德軍只要調動邊防、機槍和足夠砲兵，便能逐個奪回被切斷的據點。德國在9月戰役中取得的縱深，使波蘭短期反攻失去扭轉戰局的能力。真正改變平衡的是1921年波蘭第6西里西亞師投入，以及英法聯軍把停火執行與主要車站、道路上的人員部署結合，使戰爭由雙方自行決定轉為受國際監督。這種干預沒有讓任何一國取得整個西里西亞，卻直接促成停火線、劃界程序及投票期間的軍隊隔離。政治結果仍由公民投票而非戰場勝負決定，但軍事部署塑造了哪些地區在投票前由何方控制，也使新邊界沿煤礦與鐵路切開原工業區，留下兩套不同的行政、供應與防衛體系。
impactEn: In military terms, the three major risings demonstrated that insurgents could seize cities rapidly by dispersed attacks and railway junctions, but could seldom convert temporary occupation into a defensible theatre. In the first two phases, the principal limitations were not simply the number of weapons but inadequate heavy artillery, incompatible calibres, fragmented command and vulnerable lateral supply routes. Once the Germans could move Grenzschutz, machine guns and sufficient artillery against the isolated positions, they recovered them one by one. The depth gained by Germany in September deprived Polish counterattacks of the capacity to reverse the situation. The true balance was altered by the entry of the Polish 6th Silesian Division in January 1921 and by the combination of an Allied ceasefire mission with troops deployed at important stations and along roads. This converted a conflict decided by the belligerents into one under international supervision. The intervention did not give either country all of Upper Silesia, but it directly produced the ceasefire line, the demarcation process and the military separation during the plebiscite. Sovereignty was ultimately determined by the vote rather than by battlefield victory, although military deployments shaped which authority controlled each area before the ballot and left a new frontier cutting through the former coal and railway system, with separate administrative, supply and defence structures on either side.
result: 最後一役始於1921年1月17日，波蘭第6西里西亞師由切申方向越過邊界，奪取普什琴後向派斯科維采推進；德軍利用希維爾克拉涅茨、科祖、戈萊尤夫、布熱日尼察與海爾姆一線的砲兵和機槍據點抵抗，波軍則以師屬火炮及較完整的連續補給逐個攻擊。德軍在海爾姆周邊仍能維持局部陣線，但無法再向切申方向擴張。1月下旬，英法代表及進駐部隊控制關鍵交通點並要求停火，雙方遂沿當時的接觸線分開；此後數月仍發生零星射擊與砲火交換，但已不再形成大規模攻勢。德波劃界委員會依5月15日公布的方案分配投票區，波蘭取得卡托維茲、Bytom、Chorzów、扎布熱及達布羅瓦等構成的東部工業帶，德國保住格利維切、奧波萊、拉齊布日等西部與北部行政區；波蘭於1922年建立上西里西亞省，德國則維持自己的西里西亞省行政體系。軍事上，波蘭沒有得到全部西里西亞，波蘭起義軍若沒有第6師介入也未能守住任何大片新區；德軍則在1920年9月挫敗波軍攻勢，並保住由投票結果判定的西部、北部地區。最終結果不是戰役單方面宣布的征服，而是波蘭獲得集中而重要的工業區、德國保住另一組投票區，兩國邊界同時穿過煤田、鐵路和城鎮所形成的整體工業網絡。
resultEn: The final campaign began on 17 January 1921, when the Polish 6th Silesian Division crossed the frontier from the Cieszyn direction, captured Pszczyna and advanced toward Pyskowice. The Germans resisted along the Świerklaniec, Kozu, Golejów, Brzeżnica and Chelm axis with artillery and machine-gun positions, while the Polish troops attacked successive objectives with divisional guns and a more continuous supply system. Germany could still maintain a local line around Chelm but could no longer expand toward Cieszyn. In late January, British and French representatives and deployed troops secured important transport points and demanded a ceasefire. The opposing forces separated along their then-contact line; isolated exchanges and artillery fire continued for several months, but large-scale offensives did not resume. The German-Polish boundary commission implemented the division announced on 15 May. Poland received a compact eastern industrial belt comprising districts containing Katowice, Bytom, Chorzów, Zabrze and Dąbrowa, while Germany retained western and northern administrative areas that included Gliwice, Opole and Racibórz. Poland established the Upper Silesian Voivodeship in 1922, and Germany maintained its own provincial administration in Upper Silesia. Militarily, Poland did not receive all of Upper Silesia, and the insurgent force could not have retained a substantial new area without the arrival of the 6th Division. Germany had defeated the Polish offensive in September 1920 and preserved the western and northern districts later assigned by the vote. The outcome was not a unilateral conquest proclaimed on the battlefield: Poland gained a concentrated and strategically important industrial region, Germany retained another group of plebiscite districts, and the new frontier divided the interconnected coalfield, railways and towns of the former industrial basin.
